# Overview of the revision

We thank the Editor and Reviewers for their careful and constructive assessments.

We have revised the title and inferential scope to focus explicitly on pollen assemblage dynamics from 8.5 to 2.0 ka BP at continental-group and regional scales.

The revised article distinguishes the `r format(preparation_pool_n, big.mark = ",")`-record preparation and expert-screening pool, the `r format(original_h1_inventory_n, big.mark = ",")`-record original H1 model inventory, and smaller analysis-specific cohorts.

We promoted six representative PAP trajectories to Fig. 2 and show all ten in Supplementary Figs. S6–S15, placed the controlled spatial and temporal H1 results in Figs. 3 and 4, moved the H2 ordination to Supplementary Fig. 1, and grouped model fit, HVarPart profiles, pollen retention, PAP collinearity, reciprocal controls, SPD radius, and event sensitivity under Supplementary Result validation.

All numerical statements below are evaluated from the registered current exports during rendering.

The pollen-threshold analysis quantifies retention and bias–coverage trade-offs; it does not claim that H1 was rerun at stricter thresholds.

SPD remains the primary human proxy, and expert-screened regional pollen events are presented only as coarse, partly circular sensitivity evidence.

The revised article also explains the internally identified HVarPart extraction correction and keeps signed hierarchical contributions, zero-truncated display compositions, unique adjusted-$R^2$ fractions, and total adjusted $R^2$ conceptually separate.

Three author-only provenance or judgement items remain visibly marked for review: expert attribution, co-author approval of the two scope-decline responses, and selection among optional reviewer-suggested references.
